hook: Richard Socher was born in 1983 in Dresden, Germany, and studied at the University of Leipzig and Saarland University before moving to Stanford University, where he earned a PhD in computer science in 2014 working on neural networks for natural language processing. In 2013 he co-authored Recursive Deep Models for Semantic Compositionality Over a Sentiment Treebank, which used recursive neural networks to parse the sentiment of entire sentences from their grammatical structure and introduced the widely used Stanford Sentiment Treebank dataset. In 2014, while finishing his doctorate, he founded the AI startup MetaMind, which Salesforce acquired in 2016, after which Socher served as the company's chief scientist and head of AI. In 2020 he co-founded You.com, an AI powered search engine, where he serves as CEO, and he later co-founded the venture firm AIX Ventures. Socher is widely credited with helping bring neural network methods into mainstream natural language processing research.
